header: One work order, from phone call to signature
subheadline: One chiller failure at a food plant in Wels, from the call at 06:40 to the signed job sheet at 11:15. Each step is a screen the team uses.

items.title: The call arrives with its history
items.description: The caller's site, the asset and the last three visits open together. Whoever answers sees that the chiller was serviced in April and is under warranty.

items.title: Dispatch picks the nearest qualified van
items.description: The board filters by skill, certificate and distance, and shows what each technician would have to drop. Marek is 18 minutes away with the right refrigerant.

items.title: The customer signs on the tablet
items.description: Parts, hours and photos of the new valve go into the job sheet. The customer signs, and the draft invoice is ready before the van leaves.
